shots.caption: 第三个没有夏天的冬季。
shots.english: The third winter without a summer.
shots.spoken: 第三个没有夏天的冬季。

shots.caption: 村庄被白雪掩埋，死者从冰下归来。
shots.english: Snow buries the villages. The dead return from beneath the ice.
shots.spoken: 村庄被白雪掩埋，死者从冰下归来。

shots.caption: 天边，巨狼追逐最后的太阳与月亮。
shots.english: On the horizon, great wolves pursue the last sun and moon.
shots.spoken: 天边，巨狼追逐最后的太阳与月亮。

shots.caption:
赫列姆率军渡过冰海。
在永夜降临之前，击退它们。
shots.english:
Hrym leads his army across the frozen sea.
Drive them back before endless night falls.
shots.spoken: 赫列姆率军渡过冰海。在永夜降临之前，击退它们。

shots.caption:
这里是赫尔海姆，
未能进入英灵殿的死者之国。
shots.english:
This is Helheim, the realm of those
who were never received in Valhalla.
shots.spoken: 这里是赫尔海姆，未能进入英灵殿的死者之国。

shots.caption: 加姆守着入口，锁链仍将它束缚。
shots.english: Garm guards the entrance, still held by his chains.
shots.spoken: 加姆守着入口，锁链仍将它束缚。

shots.caption: 世界树的根下，尼德霍格日夜啃噬。
shots.english: Beneath the World Tree, Nidhogg gnaws without rest.
shots.spoken: 世界树的根下，尼德霍格日夜啃噬。

shots.caption:
海拉的亡者大军正登船。
在纳吉尔法尔起航之前，击败她。
shots.english:
Hel's army of the dead is boarding.
Defeat her before Naglfar sets sail.
shots.spoken: 海拉的亡者大军正登船。在纳吉尔法尔起航之前，击败她。

shots.caption:
彩虹桥正在崩塌，
诸神与巨人走向同一片战场。
shots.english:
The rainbow bridge is falling.
Gods and giants march to the same battlefield.
shots.spoken: 彩虹桥正在崩塌，诸神与巨人走向同一片战场。

shots.caption: 托尔举起战锤，迎向尘世巨蟒。
shots.english: Thor raises his hammer to face the World Serpent.
shots.spoken: 托尔举起战锤，迎向尘世巨蟒。

shots.caption: 奥丁握紧长枪，魔狼挣断了最后的锁链。
shots.english: Odin grips his spear. The wolf breaks his final chain.
shots.spoken: 奥丁握紧长枪，魔狼挣断了最后的锁链。

shots.caption:
战场尽头，苏尔特举起炎之剑。
在世界燃尽之前，击败他。
shots.english:
At the far end of the field, Surtr raises his burning sword.
Defeat him before the world is consumed.
shots.spoken: 战场尽头，苏尔特举起炎之剑。在世界燃尽之前，击败他。
